name: Applied Dexterity
description: Applied Dexterity was a surgical robotics spin-out founded by researchers from the University of Washington and the University of California, Santa Cruz, in Seattle, Washington, USA. The company distributed and supported the open-architecture [Raven-II](/robot/raven_II) surgical robotics research platform for academic laboratories before ceasing commercial operations.

status.note: Ceased commercial operations; research support contracts and corporate website wound down by 2026.
